name: dagonizer-32
description: Revision 3: role assignment now matches the Dagonizer seal's real pixel-coverage proportions, measured directly (~75% void/near-black, ~25% silver/steel, ~0.4% each for the cyan and violet gem accents; a third 'gold' hue was confirmed to be an extraction artifact from an unrelated version-badge asset and has been dropped). brand is now the steel/silver identity color driving most of the site's structural chrome and 9 of 11 syntax roles; brand2 (cyan) and brand3 (violet) are the two real gem families, restricted to a small, genuinely sparing set of accent roles (link, focusRing, exactly two syntax tokens, and the four low-chroma status roles) so their footprint in the design matches their footprint in the mark, instead of driving the entire brand/link/syntax-highlighting system as in the prior revision.

roles.name: bg
roles.description: Page body: darkest neutral surface

roles.name: bgAlt
roles.description: Sidebar / nav / panels: raised neutral surface

roles.name: bgElv
roles.description: Code blocks / deep elevation: darkest available neutral

roles.name: bgSoft
roles.description: Hover / lift surface: slightly lighter neutral than bgAlt

roles.name: text
roles.description: Primary body text: lightest available neutral

roles.name: text2
roles.description: Secondary text: next-lightest neutral

roles.name: text3
roles.description: Tertiary text / captions: mid neutral

roles.name: divider
roles.description: Borders and dividers: mid-low neutral

roles.name: brand
roles.description: Primary brand identity: the mark's real dominant silver/steel color (near-zero chroma, ~25% real pixel coverage vs the gems' ~0.4% each) — root for most structural chrome and 9 of 11 syntax roles, bracketed to the brightest measured steel pixel (#c5d0d2, L.85/C.012)

roles.name: brand2
roles.description: Secondary brand accent: real cyan gem root, bracketed to the seal's actual cyan gem-dot average (measured directly from opaque pixels: avg L.67/C.11/H223 across the two seal images, ~0.40% of total pixels) — clears Lc45 with zero correction

roles.name: brand3
roles.description: Tertiary brand accent: real violet gem root, bracketed to the seal's brightest violet gem-highlight pixels (measured directly: L.82/C.09/H281, ~0.41% of total pixels) — clears Lc45 with a large margin

roles.name: link
roles.description: Hyperlink text: derived from brand2 (cyan gem), own lightness step

roles.name: linkHover
roles.description: Hyperlink hover/active: brighter variant of link

roles.name: selectionBg
roles.description: Text selection highlight: low-chroma dark overlay; steel-derived per revision 3 (was void-derived)

roles.name: focusRing
roles.description: Keyboard focus outline: derived from brand3 (violet gem), own lightness step

roles.name: success
roles.description: Success state: derived from brand2 (cyan gem), own lightness step, low-chroma muted variant

roles.name: warning
roles.description: Warning state: derived from brand3 (violet gem), own lightness step, low-chroma muted variant

roles.name: danger
roles.description: Error/danger state: derived from brand3 (violet gem), own lightness step, low-chroma muted variant

roles.name: info
roles.description: Informational state: derived from brand2 (cyan gem), own lightness step, low-chroma muted variant

roles.name: scrollbarThumb
roles.description: Scrollbar thumb: muted mid neutral

roles.name: codeInlineBg
roles.description: Inline code background: distinct from block-level bgElv, slightly lighter; steel-derived per revision 3 (was void-derived)

roles.name: syntaxKeyword
roles.description: Syntax: keywords — derived from brand2 (cyan gem), one of exactly two colored syntax tokens

roles.name: syntaxString
roles.description: Syntax: string literals — derived from brand3 (violet gem), one of exactly two colored syntax tokens

roles.name: syntaxNumber
roles.description: Syntax: numeric literals — steel-derived (matches the mark's real dominant coverage), not gem

roles.name: syntaxComment
roles.description: Syntax: comments — muted neutral, intentionally recessive, no chroma

roles.name: syntaxFunction
roles.description: Syntax: function/method names — steel-derived (matches the mark's real dominant coverage), not gem

roles.name: syntaxType
roles.description: Syntax: types/interfaces/classes — steel-derived (matches the mark's real dominant coverage), not gem

roles.name: syntaxVariable
roles.description: Syntax: variable identifiers — near-neutral, dimmer than primary text

roles.name: syntaxConstant
roles.description: Syntax: constants/enum members — steel-derived (matches the mark's real dominant coverage), not gem

roles.name: syntaxOperator
roles.description: Syntax: operators/punctuation — subdued neutral, no chroma

roles.name: syntaxTag
roles.description: Syntax: JSX/HTML tag names — steel-derived (matches the mark's real dominant coverage), not gem

roles.name: syntaxAttribute
roles.description: Syntax: JSX/HTML attribute names — steel-derived (matches the mark's real dominant coverage), not gem; lower chroma than syntaxFunction for distinction
